name: personal-plugins
description: Hand-authored Claude Code plugins: guardrails, a plan gate, a dual-loop DevSecOps workflow and .NET knowledge.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Guardrail hooks: destructive commands, force-push/merge, infra destroy, credential reads, secrets in rc files, plus a canary that warns when the guardrail is silently broken.

plugins.name: plan-gate
plugins.description: /plan-gate <plan.md>: a Stop hook that keeps Claude working through a checklist until done or BLOCKED.

plugins.name: devsecops-workflow
plugins.description: Dual-loop planning, adversarial implementer/tester testing, mandatory execution verification.

plugins.name: dotnet-kit
plugins.description: Path-scoped .NET 10 / C# 14 conventions and compile-verified knowledge skills. Existing repo conventions win.

plugins.name: review-loop
plugins.description: Harness-neutral review CLI: diff scan for secrets, hidden Unicode and new dependencies, plus read-only model finder/verifier workers in a stripped scratch worktree.
